# iCliniq

> iCliniq is an AI-powered telemedicine platform providing 24/7 online doctor consultations across 80+ medical specialties with 4500+ verified physicians globally.

iCliniq combines artificial intelligence with real doctor expertise to deliver instant medical consultations through multiple channels including text chat, phone, and video. The platform serves patients worldwide while maintaining rigorous editorial standards, HIPAA/GDPR compliance, and a comprehensive medical review team.

## Core Consultation Services

- [Ask a Doctor Online](https://www.icliniq.com/ask-a-doctor-online): iCliniq main platform: online doctor consultations with 4500+ doctors across 80+ specialties
- [Video Chat with a Doctor](https://www.icliniq.com/video-chat-with-doctor): Face-to-face video consultations with doctors across 80+ medical specialties
- [Phone Consultation with a Doctor](https://www.icliniq.com/phone-a-doctor): Phone consultation service with doctors from 80+ specialties for instant medical advice
- [Live Chat with a Doctor](https://www.icliniq.com/ask-a-doctor-online/icq100): Live chat with doctors for instant medical advice and second opinions

## Specialty Consultations

- [Ask an Obstetrician and Gynecologist Online](https://www.icliniq.com/ask-a-doctor-online/obstetrician-and-gynecologist): Consult experienced obstetrician-gynecologists online for pregnancy and women's health advice

## For Healthcare Professionals

- [Join iCliniq - Global Telehealth Platform for Physicians](https://www.icliniq.com/are-you-a-doctor): Physician recruitment page for board-certified doctors to provide telemedicine services
- [Sign Up as a Medical Doctor](https://www.icliniq.com/users/doctor-profile-personal-details): Doctor signup form for medical professionals to join iCliniq platform globally

## Medical Information & Education

- [Health Questions and Answers by Medical Specialty](https://www.icliniq.com/qa/specialities): Browse thousands of medical Q&A organized by specialty for health information
- [iCliniq Health and Wellness Blog](https://blog.icliniq.com): Health and wellness blog with disease awareness, symptom guides, and patient education
- [Expert Webinars on Healthcare Topics](https://www.icliniq.com/webinar): Live webinars with healthcare experts on health, wellness, and medical education topics
